questions_and_answers.question_text: Put the following sentences in the right order for conversation: A: Kochira desu ka? / B: Hai, irasshaimase. / C: Chotto sumimasen. / D: Kono kamera o misete kudasai. / E: Ee.

answers.answer_text: B, C, D, A, E (B: Hai, irasshaimase. / C: Chotto sumimasen. / D: Kono kamera o misete kudasai. / A: Kochira desu ka? / E: Ee.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Put the following sentences in the right order for conversation: A: Moo sukoshi yasui no wa arimasu ka? / B: Akusesarii desu. / C: Kore wa nan desu ka? / D: Kochira ni gozaimasu.

answers.answer_text: C, B, A, D (C: Kore wa nan desu ka? / B: Akusesarii desu. / A: Moo sukoshi yasui no wa arimasu ka? / D: Kochira ni gozaimasu.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Put the following sentences in the right order for conversation: A: Soo desu ka. / B: Chotto sumimasen. / C: Moo sukoshi ookii no wa arimasu ka? / D: Kono seetaa o misete kudasai. / E: Okyakusama, ainiku desu ga... / F: Hai, doozo.

answers.answer_text: B, D, F, C, E, A (B: Chotto sumimasen. / D: Kono seetaa o misete kudasai. / F: Hai, doozo. / C: Moo sukoshi ookii no wa arimasu ka? / E: Okyakusama, ainiku desu ga... / A: Soo desu ka.)

questions_and_answers.question_text: Put the following sentences in the right order for conversation: A: Kore desu ka? Doozo. / B: Moo sukoshi chigau katachi no wa arimasu ka? / C: Sono burausu o misete kudasai. / D: Irasshaimase. / E: Sumimasen, ainiku desu ga...

answers.answer_text: D, C, A, B, E (D: Irasshaimase. / C: Sono burausu o misete kudasai. / A: Kore desu ka? Doozo. / B: Moo sukoshi chigau katachi no wa arimasu ka? / E: Sumimasen, ainiku desu ga...)
